description: React component for managing and displaying OpenAI assistants, including loading, adding, editing, and searching assistants with UI elements and API interactions.

methods.name: loadExisting
methods.description: Prepares and shows the dialog to load an existing assistant.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates the search state based on user input.

methods.name: onAssistantSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an assistant and triggers adding it.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Prepares and shows the dialog to add a new assistant.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares and shows the dialog to edit an existing assistant.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Confirms changes and refreshes the assistant list.

methods.name: filterAssistants
methods.description: Filters assistants based on search input.
